## Clean-room checklist

- [ ] This is original work, or derived only from a written spec in this organization.
- [ ] No vendor binaries, firmware, decompiled output, or third-party codeplugs are included.
- [ ] New behavioral claims link to a spec section that states its provenance.
- [ ] Commits are signed off with `git commit -s`.
- [ ] Destructive operations require confirmation and have a documented recovery path.
- [ ] Hardware-dependent behavior was tested on a bench, not on a live system.
